gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-001 identifies the same failed induction calculation: from A_t=P_t bar(A_t)Q_t^top one obtains the Gramian with P_t^top on the left and P_t on the right, whereas the proof uses the reversed orientation. It also correctly identifies that the subsequent algebra depends on this false relation.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The proof of the orthogonal equivalence proposition uses an invalid transpose orientation when transforming the left Gramian under a generally nonsymmetric orthogonal factor, so the ensuing identity and update do not follow.

component_coverage.gold_component: The induction proof applies the orthogonal factor with the wrong transpose orientation in the transformed left Gramian, invalidating the subsequent induction identity and old L-update.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction explicitly derives the correct P_t^top(A_tA_t^top)P_t expression, contrasts it with the proof's P_t(A_tA_t^top)P_t^top expression, notes that it is false for nonsymmetric orthogonal P_t, and states that subsequent algebra is built on it. This fully diagnoses the gold defect.
